turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Mr. Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, Doctor. Got some pain here and there, but not too bad lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you rate your pain on a scale from 0 to 10 for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 4 or 5? It's manageable, but I feel some discomfort when moving.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you want to vomit? Sometimes spinal anesthesia can cause that.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit queasy earlier, but settled down after they gave me something. No vomiting, thank God.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Breathing comfortable? Any shortness of breath or airway issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing's fine. Throat a bit sore from the tube, but I can talk okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything during the surgery? Sometimes patients recall bits.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not much, Doctor. Felt some pressure here and there, heard voices, then woke up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Your blood pressure's stable, but we're watching your diabetes and kidney function. Any concerns?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, worried about sugar levels, but nurse said it's under control. Urine output's a bit less, but no swelling.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We'll keep monitoring. Stay hydrated and follow your meds. Any other issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, all good. Thank you, Doctor. I'll rest and drink more water.
